3-1(a): rgya gar skad du/ma hA pa na sa ma a bi bo d+hi sa ta ma hA tan tra
3-2(a): kha ya ma la nA ma/bod skad du/theg pa chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa byang
3-3(a): chub lam gyi rgyud chen nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das mi
3-4(a): las 'phags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i
3-5(a): dus gcig na//bcom ldan 'dasa mi las 'phags pa'i rgyal po dga' ldan lha'i
3-6(a): gnas/rin po che'i gzhal med khang chen po na/lhag pa'i 'khor 'jam
3-7(a): da pa la dang /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dang /mi 'jigs pa dang yon
3-8(a): tan mtha' yas rgyal po dang /stobs po che la sogs pa'i rigs can rnams
3-9(a): dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so//de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi
3-10(a): gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin gyis sgo bsam mi khyab par bstan pa ni/rdul med rdul
3-11(a): bral dri med dang //rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed kyi//sangs rgyas sras rnams
4-1(a): gang byung ba//dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes//re re'i zhing du sku gsung
4-2(a): thugs//lham me lhan ne lhang de ba//ma g.yos bzhin du 'phros pa ni/
4-3(a): mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gsang ba las//skra ni gdul bya'i grangs dang mnyam/
4-4(a): gsung ni sgra skad ji tsam par//thugs ni mi g.yo kun la khyab//yon tan nam
4-5(a): mkha' mdzod mnga' ba'i//'phrin las tha da da don gcig ste//nam mkha'i
4-6(a): mtha' la raba gnas pa'i//sku gsung thugs kyi snying po yi//khams gsum pa
4-7(a): yi no bo nyid//ma dag pa yi mun pa la//dag pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/
4-8(a): nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor sad byed pa'i//dad pa tshos dbyings rgya mtsho las/
4-9(a): ye shes snang ba la me ba'i//yid bzhin nor bu'i sems nyid la//theg pa sna
4-10(a): tshogs thabs tshul gyis//dgos 'dod sna tshogs don mchog gsum//tha ma
4-11(a): 'bring dang mchog gyur pa'i//'gro kun lam la dgod par mdzad//rang nyid
4-12(a): 'dod pa las grol nas//sems can yongs su smin pa'i phyir//theg pa 'di
4-13(a): la 'byung 'dod gang //zhe 'dod skyo ba'i blo spangs te//byang chub sems ni
4-14(a): gcig spyod pas//kun mkhyen yon tan 'byung ba la//theg pa chen po'i don
4-15(a): la ni//bag med spyod pa rab spangs te//dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa yis//
4-16(a): bshes gnyen zhi du la nyer zhi ba'i//yon tan bcom ldan lung gis phyug/brtse
4-17(a): ba'i bdagnyid skyo ba spang //kun la snyoms pa'i yab yum lags//'khor
4-18(a): ba'i yid sun dad par ldan//bag yod dran pa'i blo gros can//bdog pa
4-19(a): kun kyang tshos phyir srog/'dor nus rnal 'byor rab tu brtson//rang gi
4-20(a): sems ni 'dul ba dang //gzhan gyi sems ni gzung ba'i don/bsod
4-21(a): nams ye shes 'phel ba'i rgya//tshul dang mi mthun med pa ca//kun tu spyad
5-1(a): theg pa chen pa na mngan par thags pa byang chab lam tsi cad chen nam mkha' dang mnham pa zhas za ba
